newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Trend shows NZ dwelling authorisations fell in Aug.
newsitem.headline: Trend shows NZ dwelling authorisations fell in Aug.

text.p: New dwelling authorisations fell 3.7 percent in August on a trend estimate basis, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday.
Estimated actual new dwelling units rose 1.9 percent to 1,794 in August from August 1995.
SNZ said the trend reached a peak in April 1996 but had been declining since then.
The largest increase over the year came in Waitakere City, up from 76 to 133, Hamiliton, up from 52 to 98 and Wellington up from 41 to 83.
The largest decreases were in Auckland city, down from 150 to 104, Manukau drom from 140 to 108 and North Shore down from 129 to 101.
